name: Kingmaker core pack
why: Everything a small business needs, built in, running on the Mac itself. The owner's gift: "It all belongs inside Kingmaker."
rules: Ships: only what Kingmaker may redistribute (Ronin's own work, MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, MPL, OFL). Every item names its licence; anything 'All rights reserved' or unlicensed stays out.
Stock Mac: an item that needs Python, Homebrew or a developer tool is marked so until Kingmaker carries what it needs.
Large apps (LibreOffice, Blender, GIMP…) don't ride inside Kingmaker.app: they install on first use from their official source, one ask, with the exact size.
The owner's proprietary CRM is never in this pack: skills tied to it live in the owner's private-skills folder on their own install only.
Every skill and tool gets REA's check (lib/rea.mjs) before Kingmaker uses it.
